sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: Extreme distant aerial photograph of a vast deep blue ocean with large sweeping parallel waves. One very tiny white origami paper boat occupies less than three percent of the image, a small bright folded hull amid miles of ocean. Complete boat silhouette, huge visual scale, warm golden horizon at twilight, wide cinematic composition, realistic ocean texture, dark dramatic film contrast.
